Concept Plus Careers

Oracle Developer (CEMS)

Oracle Developer (CEMS)

About Concept Plus

Concept Plus is a mission-focused technology solutions provider that transforms IT concepts into impactful solutions for federal agencies. Headquartered in Fairfax, VA, we bring the agility, responsiveness, and customer intimacy of a small business combined with the quality and infrastructure of a larger firm.

Recognized as an award-winning Oracle partner, we have delivered innovative solutions across Defense, Intelligence, Civilian, Health IT, and Tribal sectors. Our highly certified experts build systems that drive efficiency, accelerate modernization, and ensure mission outcomes with certainty.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid life insurance, paid time off, 11 paid holidays, performance bonuses, tuition reimbursement, unlimited training, and the opportunity to thrive in a collaborative, flexible, and innovative environment.

For more information, visit www.conceptplus.com.

About the role

Concept Plus is seeking a Oracle Developer to perform sustainment tasks for CEMS database support and APIs/Interfaces. Develops and maintains CEMS Web Services APIs for existing and future CEMS interface.

What you'll do

Design, develop, and optimize PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and queries to support application features and business workflows. 
Analyze existing database code and processes to identify performance bottlenecks and implement tuning improvements. 
Collaborate with application developers, business analysts, and data teams to understand requirements and translate them into efficient database solutions. 
Develop and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and database scripts for reporting, integration, and data processing needs. 
Ensure database code follows best practices for security, reliability, reusability, and performance. 
Work with relational database structures, implementing changes, updates, and schema modifications as required. 
Perform troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis on PL/SQL components and database-related issues. 
Support deployment activities by preparing scripts, validating execution results, and ensuring smooth transitions between environments. 
Create and maintain documentation for database structures, stored procedures, data flows, and development standards.
Participate in code reviews and provide technical guidance on PL/SQL and database development standards. 
Assist with data migration, ETL processes, and integration tasks between internal and external systems.
Monitor database performance and collaborate with DBAs to optimize queries, indexes, and storage strategies.

Required Qualifications

US Citizen with active Secret Clearance
BA/BS preferrable, can be replaced by additional experience
2+ years of experience with Oracle PL/SQL 
Experience with Oracle database replication 
Knowledge of AWS and/or OCI related technologies and utilities 

Preferred Qualifications

Strong interpersonal and communications skills. 
AGILE Environment experience, DevSecOps 
Have AWS Cloud One or AWS Gov Cloud experience.

Concept Plus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As such, we will give your application full consideration without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.
